newsitem.title: HUNGARY: DLR,MARK,BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: DLR,MARK,BASKET DEALS DOMINATE HUNGARY FX FUTURES.

text.p: Dollar/mark basket deals featured on Hungary's currency futures market on Monday but the two currencies also dominated single-currency deals.

Basket deals concentrated on the December maturity on both the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) and the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), with the mark falling 0.3 on the BCE to 115.3 forints and dollar rising 0.95 to 198.4.
The equivalent movements on the BSE were 0.43 up to 115.27 for the December mark and 0.95 down to 198.25 for the dollar.
Large deals in the December mark alone also featured on the BCE as well as deals for the September dollar, which rose 1.3 foritns to 192.5.
Turnover was moderate on both markets, totalling 3.58 billion forints on the BCE and 888 million forints on the much smaller BSE.
